connect.label: Sign in to play
connect.note: Sign in with Google or your Hero Key. Dalaran plays in your browser with no download; the whole world uses your own 3.3.5a game files, read on your computer and never uploaded.

features.title: Start at 1 or 80
features.text: Each new character chooses: the normal game from level 1, or a boost to 80 with a spec kit.

features.title: Spec kits
features.text: Boosted characters get a PvE and a PvP set for their spec.

features.title: Armory at 80
features.text: Free gear at level 80, in Dalaran, arenas and battlegrounds.

features.title: Ride from level 1
features.text: New characters start with Apprentice Riding and their race's mount.

features.title: Forever UI
features.text: The modern-style interface is on in the browser; add ?foreverui=0 for the classic look.
